annotations.title: Get the full text of a law section

description: Fetch full verbatim text by id or citation, or pass references for a batch of up to 10. Each batch item has its own result/error. Includes provenance (official source URL, current-through or vintage label, retrieval time), parent path, and prev/next siblings. The text is reproduced exactly as published by the official source; nothing is added or removed except publisher editorial matter, which we never carry.

citation.description: Full citation, e.g. California Civil Code 1950.5

references.description: Batch of section ids or complete citations
